messages.content: Return only JSON matching the schema. Classify one bounded economic-border repair from supplied evidence. Do not invent a second transaction, authority, price, customer value, or reinvestment act.

Current territory: one real Aagaard-to-AGRODAO witnessed commodity exchange already has sovereign ask, sovereign bid, exact-match price discovery, bilateral receipt and paired books, customer-effect witness, value-added analysis, and an advisory reinvestment hold for recurrence evidence. Finance already owns repeated-bilateral-performance-observation-service, which lawfully requires at least two distinct replayable v2 bilateral bundles and cannot infer end-user value or reinvestment from count two. No second occurrence exists and none may be fabricated. Observed runtime defect: its response content ID omits target; two actors reusing one malformed solicitation ID received different-target Rejects with the same ID, and both incompatible values were blindly appended. The runtime also blindly duplicates replay, does not fail closed on durable identity collision, weakly binds the embedded provider offer/capability, and writes observations without stable event/EAVT replay identities. Choose the next cycle: harden this existing repeated-performance border before real recurrence; wait and change nothing until autonomous recurrence; or a different bounded act. Contact-note engineering obligations require authorization-bearing transitions to be replay-scoped and refusals typed and durable. Any repair must remain Finance-local and must not create a trade, recurrence evidence, performance result, end-user value, allocation, price, contract, or market act.
